name: PT WIR ASIA Tbk
summary: PT WIR ASIA Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides digital reality technology development services in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates through: Promotion and Advertising via an Interactive Platform; Software Application Development; Brand and IT Consulting; Goods Sales via an Interactive Platform; Digital Product Sales via an Interactive Platform; and Transaction Commission via Inter Platform segment. Its services include augmented reality, Virtual Reality, and Artificial Intelligence based technology solutions, interactive platform services, and a brand consultancy service. PT WIR ASIA Tbk was founded in 2009 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
